collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: An elder learning the nose flute late in life practices every evening, badly: offer to learn too, or just listen.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Late in life, and for no particular reason, (subject) has decided to learn the nose flute. (subject.He/she) has had one carved, and has been practicing every evening behind (subject.his/her) hut. The sound so far has been compared, by different villagers, to a seabird in trouble, a door, and wind in a hollow log. (friend) has come to listen.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) has a flute carved too. Now there are two terrible flutes behind the hut every evening. They are terrible together for a whole season. Then, one evening, they play three notes in a row that sound almost like music, and both of them stop and stare at each other in astonishment.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) sits and listens to the whole practice. (subject) plays a long, wobbly tune that might be a song (subject.he/she) knew as a child. It isn't good. It isn't meant to be. When it's over, (friend) claps. (subject) bows deeply. (subject.He/she) will be out here again tomorrow, whether anyone listens or not.
